decision_scope: economic risk definition; other training gates remain required
exit_principle: Compare expected further executable net value with closing now, including costs; no fixed price-loss or time threshold.
risk_utility_policy: Preserve existing source-owned penalties; no new arbitrary penalty coefficient.
cost_policy: Preserve bound bid/ask, round-trip execution costs and financing; include first fill-minute once.
position_policy: One fixed-notional XAUUSD position at a time, no pyramiding; Entry chooses only when no position is open.
position_policy_basis: User requested continuation with the prioritized recommendation and realistic position use; no live capital allocation.
physical_accounting: Same liquidation-value increments, costs and financing as v3; only learned coordinates and direct target change.
